phrase_croissance: Steady growth in revenue and operating income over the last 4 fiscal years; recent years count more, a decline weighs three times as much as a rise.

phrase_bilan_fin: High equity relative to assets and a large size make a financial company sturdier.
phrase_dynamique: Did the stock beat the S&P 500 over one year (skipping the last month), steadily rather than in a single jump?
AVANCE: Average gap to the S&P 500, annualised (extreme rises neutralised)
phrase_garde_fou: Each light is scored from -1 to +1: green from +0.33, red below -0.33. An orange or red average excludes the company.
